component.name: Wisp
component.summary: The web browser that's on your side

description.p: Wisp is a quiet web browser with a small living companion. The wisp, a glowing flame with a friendly face, notices how your time online really feels: it brightens somewhere that restores you, clouds over during a long scroll, and perks up again when you step away. It never blocks a page or scolds you.

ul.li: Hover the wisp to see, in plain words, what is moving it
Home: a garden that grows on good days and never wilts, a greeting that notices what went well, and good places to go
The wisp's days: today, the week and the weeks before, with no minutes or scores
About 2,300 sites sorted by published research on wellbeing online, and yours to change
Private by design: nothing leaves your computer, and the addresses you visit are never recorded
